text:
Avery: Morning all — quick weekly leaders check-in. High level: (1) product launches on track, (2) tighten data-retention policy draft, (3) post-incident follow-ups and current metrics. TL;DR: APAC private beta next Tues, p99 latency trending down but error budget burn last week, new retention policy proposal attached.

Ravi: Great — small ask: can we confirm GA gating criteria for Private? I want to lock the checklist by EOD Thu.

Maya: On GA gating: infra perf (p99 <= 200ms), SLO error budget <= 1% weekly, successful canary rollout results on Dedicated regions. We hit p99=185ms avg this week.

Liam: Incident recap (short): Friday outage root cause = autoscaler race on a rare pod preemption + model swap. Mitigations deployed: serialized model-rollout lock + fallback to smaller variant. TL;DR: no customer data exposed. Postmortem draft in #postmortems.

Sofia: Can we announce APAC beta seats to growth next week? I want a short blurb and FAQ to hand to early partners.

Avery: Yes — comms plan: internal announce Mon morning, partner invites Tue morning after the beta flip. @Sofia please coordinate the FAQ. :rocket:

Eden: Quick finance note: cost per 1k tokens improved by ~12% month-over-month thanks to batching/quant changes. That buys runway to fund two more ops hires this quarter if we keep trends.

Maya: Re: safety net — added an automatic rollback threshold to canaries (error rate >0.7% over 5m triggers roll back and opens a pager). Tested in staging — looks stable.

Liam: Action item for eng: please ensure all model-serving deployments include the new rollout-lock header and the rollback threshold in config. I pushed a template in the eng-runtime repo.

Ravi: On the policy side — data-retention draft: 90-day default logs retention, 365-day opt-in for enterprise with KMS control. That aligns with SOC2/ISO asks. Comments welcomed. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/data-retention-draft

Avery: I'm comfortable with the defaults but want legal to sign off on the enterprise opt-in wording. @Eden can you loop in GC?

Eden: Will do. I'll ping legal and get a note in their queue today.

Sofia: One quick metric ask for next week: product to provide a short list of 3 prompt sets we want to track for quality regressions post-rollout. We'll wire them into Redwood Optimize.

Maya: Adding that to Eng backlog, will deliver by Wed.

ops-bot: Deployment: canary to apac-private succeeded — 3/3 pods healthy. (deploy-2623) :white_check_mark:

Avery: Nice. Final asks: 1) leaders — confirm checklist items you own by EOD Thu, 2) product + eng: finalize canary gating docs, 3) PM/growth: partner comms ready Mon. I'll send a short note to the company Monday morning summarizing this.

Ravi: Ack, will confirm checklist by EOD Thu.

Maya: Confirmed.

Liam: Ack, postmortem + mitigations in #postmortems by Monday.

Sofia: Comms draft ready Mon 9am.

Eden: Looping legal now.

Avery: Thanks team — quick, focused week. If anything urgent, escalate in #release-war-room. :eyes:
thread_text_short: Avery posts weekly leaders check-in: APAC beta, data-retention draft, incident recap, metrics, and action items. Team replies with acks and owners.
